name: CADCraft
tagline: Computer-aided design and drafting, reimagined in pure Rust
blurb: The command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and drawings you already know.
description:
CADCraft is a parametric 2D and 3D drafting suite built for mechanical designers and architects.

Includes DWG/DXF import and export, precise geometric constraints, coordinate input, block libraries, and support for automation via AI agents.

install.label: Cargo / Build from source
install.command: git clone https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft.git && cd cadcraft && cargo run --release
